shots.excerpt: Medium two-shot at seat level, lavender-blue light: the man sleeps as dark veins creep up his neck; she frowns and slides her headphones down. Slow subtle push-in.
highlight: dark veins creep up his neck
shots.voice: Shot 3. A quiet two-shot with a slow push-in. Dark veins creep up his neck while she starts to notice.

shots.excerpt: Perfectly symmetrical wide shot down the central aisle. Must show: dozens of yellow oxygen masks dropping at once; light shifts from white to flashing emergency red.
shots.voice: Shot 6. A symmetrical aisle shot. Every oxygen mask drops at once and the cabin flips to emergency red.

shots.excerpt: Medium close-up, frontal, locked-off: the pilot facing camera, eyes now solid glowing white, face pale with dark veins, instrument lights behind him.
shots.voice: Shot 14. A locked-off frontal close-up. The pilot stares back with solid white eyes, and you know it's over.

shots.excerpt: Low-angle medium-wide in red light. Must show: she floats weightless above her seat, held by a loose seatbelt, long hair streaming upward, masks and phones floating.
shots.voice: Shot 17. A low angle in red light. The dive makes her float, hair streaming upward, debris drifting around her.

shots.excerpt: Locked-off extreme wide of the night city. Must show: a massive orange fireball erupts behind the mountain ridge and swells into a mushroom of flame.
shots.voice: Shot 20. A still, extreme wide of the city. Then a massive fireball rises behind the mountains.
